traders_selected.Kristjan Kullamagi (Qullamaggie): Swing trader active 2013-, public streams and his site (qullamaggie.com 'My 3 timeless setups'), Chat With Traders interview. Breakout setup: a 30-100%+ move in 1-3 months, then an orderly consolidation with higher lows and tightening range for 2 weeks-2 months near the 10/20-day MAs; buy the break of the range high; stop at the low of the entry day; sell 1/3-1/2 after 3-5 days and trail the rest with the 10- or 20-day MA. Secondary summaries: tikamalma.substack.com 'Qullamaggie Swing Trading Setups', tradingresourcehub.substack.com interview notes.
traders_selected.Mark Minervini: US Investing Championship winner 1997 and again 2021 (recent); books 'Trade Like a Stock Market Wizard' (2013), 'Think & Trade Like a Champion' (2017). Trend Template (8 criteria): price > 150d and 200d SMA; 150d > 200d; 200d rising at least 1 month; 50d > 150d and 200d; price > 50d; price >= 30% above 52-week low; price within 25% of 52-week high; relative strength rank >= 70. Summaries: chartmill.com 'Mark Minervini Trend Template', mql5.com 'Automating Classic Market Methods (Part 4)'.

rules_fixed_here_because_ambiguous.relative strength: percentile of the 126-day close return within the current U50

trials.QM1_BREAKOUT_U50: c = cut. Prior move: max(close[c-60..c-10]) / min(close[c-90..c-30]) >= 1.30 with the min's day before the max's day. Consolidation: over c-14..c-1 the close range max/min - 1 <= 0.20, and that range <= the close range over c-29..c-15. Surfing: close[c-1] >= SMA20[c-1]. Trigger: close[c] > max(close[c-14..c-1]). Entry: long 5% of capital at the open of day i if not held and fewer than 20 positions (ties by higher prior move). Exits (checked on close of each later cut, executed at the next trading open): stop = close < min(close[entry_cut-14..entry_cut-1]) (consolidation low); from the 5th holding day on, close < SMA10; 60 holding days maximum. No partial sales (single exit; stated simplification).
trials.MV1_TREND_TEMPLATE_U50: At cut c a coin passes if all 8 hold: close > SMA150 and > SMA200; SMA150 > SMA200; SMA200[c] > SMA200[c-21]; SMA50 > SMA150 and > SMA200; close > SMA50; close >= 1.30 x min(close[c-364..c]); close >= 0.75 x max(close[c-364..c]); 126-day return percentile within U50 >= 0.70 (SMAs need full windows; any NaN -> fail). Hold the passing U50 coins equal weight (gross 1); if the passing set is unchanged the drifted weights are kept, otherwise all are reset to equal weight; flat when none pass.

after_result: Trial count +2 regardless. No variants in this thread; if nothing passes, report NOT_PROMISING and stop.
